faq.q: What are Redwood Cigarettes in GTA 6?
faq.a: Redwood Cigarettes are tobaccos listed for GTA 6 on the GTA Fandom wiki. The wiki entry is the only record of them. Rockstar has not named them in a trailer, a press release or on the Grand Theft Auto VI site, so this page records the wiki listing and marks it as a community source.

faq.q: Are Redwood Cigarettes confirmed for GTA 6?
faq.a: No. A Fandom wiki page is written by fans, not by Rockstar. This site files Redwood Cigarettes as community identified, at low confidence, for that reason. The entry stays at low confidence until Rockstar or a major outlet names them.

faq.q: What does the wiki say about Redwood Cigarettes?
faq.a: The wiki gives 1 detail. Business type: tobacco. Those are wiki fields copied as they stand. No figure here was measured in the game, because the game has not released.

faq.q: Where does this Redwood Cigarettes information come from?
faq.a: From the GTA Fandom wiki page for Redwood Cigarettes, collected by the outlawdb project on 2026-09-13 and released under CC BY-SA 3.0. The source link on this page opens the wiki page itself, so you can read the same entry.

faq.q: What is still unknown about Redwood Cigarettes?
faq.a: Most of it. Redwood Cigarettes rest on a fan wiki listing and nothing else. Whether the player can enter it and whether it can be robbed or bought are both unpublished. Rockstar answers questions like this at launch, not before, so this page will change when it does.

faq.q: Will Redwood Cigarettes be in the finished GTA 6?
faq.a: Not known. A wiki listing is a claim by a fan editor, not a Rockstar statement. Plenty of business entries written before a launch never appear in the game. This site records the claim and the source, and marks the entry unconfirmed until that changes.
